app.name: Anakin
app.short_description: Scrape, map, crawl, and search the web, look up Wire site actions, AI-visibility, monitors, and sessions — all from the ticket sidebar.
app.long_description: Anakin adds ten of its web-data lookup tools to the ticket sidebar: scrape a single page, map or crawl a site, run AI-powered or multi-stage agentic search, find and run a read-only Wire catalog action against hundreds of supported sites, ask multiple AI answer engines the same question (AI Visibility), and check existing website monitors and saved browser sessions. The Monitors tab also lets an agent pause, resume, or trigger an immediate check on an existing monitor, gated behind a re-checked confirmation step — monitor deletion, monitor creation, and every other state-changing Anakin capability (submitting forms on third-party sites, signing into third-party sites, publishing new Wire actions, deleting sessions) stay out of scope for a support-ticket sidebar. Insert any lookup result straight into the ticket as an internal note or public reply — without leaving Zendesk. See the project README's "Scope" section for the full reasoning.
app.installation_instructions: Create a free API key at anakin.io/dashboard (300 credits, no card required), then paste it into the "Anakin API Key" field below. The key is stored as a secure setting: it never reaches this app's JavaScript in the browser, only Zendesk's own request proxy uses it when calling api.anakin.io on the app's behalf.

apiKey.label: Anakin API Key
apiKey.help: From anakin.io/dashboard. Sent as the X-API-Key header via Zendesk's secure request proxy — never exposed to this app's client-side JavaScript.
